# BrushColor <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Brushes](Blitz3D-Brushes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
BrushColor:Void brush:Int32, red:Float32, green:Float32, blue:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | In | Int32 | required | The brush. |
| `red` | In | Float32 | required | Red part, 0 to 255. |
| `green` | In | Float32 | required | Green part, 0 to 255. |
| `blue` | In | Float32 | required | Blue part, 0 to 255. |

## Description

Sets the color the brush multiplies onto the surface: the red, green and blue parts range from 0 to 255 and are clamped. The default is 255, 255, 255, which leaves textures unchanged.
